item: numerals sheet at phone size, 100% and 200% text
critique: On all eight sheets (normal and high contrast, 100% and 200%, backdrop and card), every glyph and separator in the gold, white, timer and timer_red finishes has an unbroken dark ink outline that grows with the text, plus a hard drop to the lower right. Normal mode adds a vertical gradient fill, and high contrast uses a flat fill with a black outline. Each finish is treated the same throughout. This matches the pass anchor's outlined, dropped HUD timer and figures.

item: numerals sheet at phone size, 100% and 200% text
critique: The roles are fixed. Gold is for values, white and cream are for neutral counts and the timer, and red-pink appears only on the low-time alarm timer. The roles hold across normal and high contrast, en and pt_br, and both grounds, with no drift. The heavy outline keeps every glyph clear of both grounds. No colour-blindness sheet was supplied, so the red timer state rests on hue plus value.
